AigcChatCompletionStream.description_en: Invokes a published Creative Agent, supporting both the lite and dedicated editions, and returns execution progress and image artifacts via Server-Sent Events (SSE). The lite edition performs text-to-image or image-to-image generation based on whether a reference image is provided. The dedicated edition uses a Planner to schedule and execute generation and editing tasks, supporting multi-turn conversations. Parameters such as the generation count and size are passed through metadata.parameters. For image URLs in the results, refer to artifacts
AigcChatCompletionStream.description_zh: 调用已发布的 Creative Agent，支持轻量版和专属版，以 SSE 返回执行进度和图片制品。轻量版根据是否提供参考图执行文生图或图生图；专属版通过 Planner 规划并执行生成、编辑任务，支持多轮会话。生成数量、尺寸等通过 metadata.parameters 传入，结果中的图片地址见 artifacts

CameraChatCompletionStream.description_en: Invokes a published Camera Agent to recognize food and beverages and detect new persons in scenes. Food recognition returns the locations and counts of targets. Person detection deduplicates against recorded portraits in the scene and returns at most one new person per request. The recognition capabilities are determined by the published configuration of the instance. Both JSON and Server-Sent Events (SSE) responses are supported. All bounding boxes use the pixel coordinates of the original image
CameraChatCompletionStream.description_zh: 调用已发布的 Camera Agent，支持食物饮品识别和场景新人检测。食物识别返回目标位置和数量；人物检测结合场景内已收录的人像去重，每次最多返回一名新人。识别能力由实例已发布配置决定，支持 JSON 和 SSE 返回，检测框均使用原图像素坐标

CuaChatCompletionStream.description_en: Invokes a published Computer Use Agent (CUA) Standard Edition instance, submits a task and the current desktop screenshot, and returns single-step computer operation decisions through Server-Sent Events (SSE). After the client executes the computer_use action, it returns the actual results and continues the call with the session ID and the latest screenshot
CuaChatCompletionStream.description_zh: 调用已发布的 Computer Use Agent（CUA）标准版，提交任务和当前桌面截图，以 SSE 返回单步电脑操作决策。客户端执行 `computer_use` 动作后回传真实结果，并携带会话 ID 和最新截图继续调用

GuiChatCompletionStream.description_en: Calls a published Mobile-Use Agent, which supports both the standard and exclusive editions. Submits the task text and the current screen screenshot, passes the device and application context through metadata, and returns the next mobile UI operation via Server-Sent Events (SSE). The UI operation is executed by the caller. After execution, subsequent calls are made with the session ID and the latest screenshot
GuiChatCompletionStream.description_zh: 调用已发布的 Mobile-Use Agent，支持标准版和专属版。提交任务文本和当前屏幕截图，通过 metadata 传入设备与应用上下文，以 SSE 返回下一步手机界面操作。界面操作由调用方执行，执行后携带会话 ID 和最新截图继续调用

PaChatCompletionStream.description_en: Invokes a published Mobile Planner Agent to initiate a conversation or node planning by using OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions messages, and returns text, model-provided thinking content, and structured tool invocations over Server-Sent Events (SSE). Supports multi-turn sessions and image inputs supported by the model. Business tools are executed by the invoker
PaChatCompletionStream.description_zh: 调用已发布的 Mobile Planner Agent，使用 OpenAI-Compatible Chat Completions 消息发起对话或任务规划，以 SSE 返回文本、模型提供的思考内容及结构化工具调用。支持多轮会话和模型支持的图片输入；业务工具由调用方执行
